verdict.rationale: The Texas Comptroller collects taxpayer data through Webfile and eSystems, so asking whether that data can be kept out of AI model training is a fair privacy-posture question for this kind of service. Nothing in the pack covers an AI-training opt-out, a data-use policy, or any AI-training disclosure. The pack covers filing, payment and open-data features, and the probes cover only machine-readability, so absence of evidence for an applicable axis is none.
